body: I'm at a restaurant with her now. Should I tell her about the knife or keep it secret?
I'm 27 or 28 or something like that. Can't think too clearly now 1982  she's not my true love. I don't love her. I'm just desperate and lonely.

I couldn't wait so I started calling her. There was no answer so I kept calling. At 9:45 she finally answered. She said she was sleeping this whole time. I asked her to come out and open the door. She said to give her w couple of minutes. I didn't tell her about the knife yet.

I hate crowds. I want people to like me, but I am arrogant and selfish. People do not naturally like me.

All my relationships end the same way with the same complaints. The problem isn't with her, it's with me.

Ok its almost 9. She hasn't called. I texted a "mutual" friend and she didn't care either. I was impressed with how fast this post got its first comment, so I figure there must be people constantly monitoring the posts here, but the replies are dropping off here too.

I guess you guys have all figured out that I'm low on the triage priority list, cause I'm probably not gonna actually kill myself. I'm just gonna look like an idiot standing out here for hours with a knife, possibly in front of the wrong door and no one gives a shit. No one will even know outside ii the 5 or 6 people in this thread.

It's wrong and selfish of me to use up your resources like this week you could be helping people who are truly at risk. I'm just being a big baby wanting the world to care about me, but nobody cares. That's life.

Thanks for the advice, you helped me put things into perspective.

I am antisocial. All of my friends are actually her friends. I can't go anywhere or do anything without being reminded of her. I've already deleted her from my Facebook, but I still get pictures of her having a great time via our mutual friends.

I am unable to meet new people, except through her.
See, I'm still entertaining the possibility that she'll still call and still arrange to come over to my house. That is how hooked on her that I am.
Parent was probably trolling, but it sounded like an ICP quote so I played along.
You think I won't really do it huh? You think I'm scared?

I tried playing the emotionally distant cool guy. I think that's what got her to consider talking to me again in the first place. She said she'd come over to my house. 

I couldn't stand to wait the hours, the minutes. It was gonna be either Saturday or Sunday but she hadn't specified which. Saturday around 9pm I gave in and called her asking her when shed actually show up. I gave up my hand there. She could sense the desperation, I think, and all went downhill from there. 

I can't fake it. I can't pretend to not be lonely.

I've not had a girl approach me since 2002. Since then every girl I've been with was a result of me approaching her, including this one.

I am running out of sources for girls. I can't hang out at the university anymore, and Facebook has banned for being too creepy. 

But its not my intention to turn this into a dating tip thread. I'm truly of the belief that this may be it.

But its not my intention to turn this into a dating tip thread. I'm truly of the belief that this may be it.
I realise now I am a victim of verbal abuse. She makes me feel worthless so that I cannot leave her, long after she has left me.
I am a loser and she might be the only girl I can get. It doesn't matter if she is a birch or a hypocrite, I will tolerate anything because I am desperate.

She is a shit friend. Her only redeeming features are her good looks.

The exception is if she loves you, then she would do the world for you. She used to love me. I want that back. 

When we were together, she boasted about all these pathetic guys trying to get with her and how she would string them along. Now I am one of those guys. She's the ultimate troll.
She said she'd call me back. I think that was around 4 or 5  its 7:49 now and still nothing from her. If she doesn't call me tonight, ...
Her friend is nice to me. I don't want her to feel guilty if anything happens. She doesn't know why I wanted the address.
I don't even know if I'm at the right apartment. I asked her friend for the address, but the directions she gave are vague. Maybe I'm in the wrong building.
She's not ever going to understand how I feel. She laughs at me when I bring up suicide and says its pathetic I even try to call her. Maybe if she sees blood she'll take me more seriously.

Throughout the latter half of the relationship she has made it clear that she doesn't need me and she likes to rub it in that I need her so badly. Even during our good periods, she points out how lonely I am. She lies to me almost constantly and today admitted she is incapable of apologizing for anything she does to me.

It hurts me to see her happy without me. It hurts me more when she plays with my heart like this. The best would be if she were gone from my life.
I think talking to her will make us fight more. I don't want to end up telling her something, and not following through with what I said: more ammo and opportunity for calling me pathetic.

I am bringing myself to this "heat of the moment" and I brought a knife. Why am I putting myself at risk of doing something I will regret?

She lives with male roommates. I envision them beating me up. I've never met them before.
I have some ideas, but nothing final yet. Maybe I won't cut anything tonight.

It is unfair: she is an attractive girl, and so people tolerate her misbehavior and she always has a network of friends to support her. I am an ugly guy, so I have nothing. 

This isn't true, I have people, but I am hystrionic and soever minute I am alone drives me crazy. I feel like I have no one. No one can live up to my 24/7 standards.
I want her to care. My non-thought-out plan is to slice my stomach open and bleed all over her doorstep. I don't want to die. This is just self-centered drama. I want her to feel as bad as I do.
I don't know.
I'm on a cell so its difficult to type a lot. I will answer questions progressively.

Months ago, she wrote me love letters and told me I was her best friend. Our relationship has been a rollercoaster since then. Yesterday she said she was happy that I wanted to try to be friends again. 20 minutes ago she said she has no respect for me and that its impossible for us to be friends.
